title: Doubly linked list with a sentinel
summary: Insert after a known node and unlink a known data node. An empty list is a sentinel whose two links point to itself.
triggers: remove a known node in constant time
traverse a linked sequence in both directions
prompts: A playlist editor has a handle to the current track. Insert another track immediately after it.
An editor keeps a handle to each open tab. Unlink a tab without scanning from the first.
invariant: Each live link has a matching reverse link, including the links through the sentinel.
mantra: Join the new neighbors in both directions.
pitfalls: Only unlink a data node that currently belongs to the list.

anchors.name: Design Linked List
anchors.trick: A sentinel lets the same four assignments insert at either end.

complexity.time: O(1) per insertion or removal given the node

mutations.explanation: Leaves the successor pointing backward at the removed node.

test: assert head.next is first and last.prev is first and head.prev is last
assert unlink(first) == 1 and last.prev is head and head.next is last
assert unlink(last) == 2 and head.next is head and head.prev is head
